shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real skin, fur, fabric and landscape texture, natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.
shared_prompts.safe_center: Keep the main subject of the photo whole inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps it whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.
shared_prompts.edit: This is an edit of image 1: the result must look like the same place photographed from the same spot. Change only what the instruction names.

assets.item: A ball / It is a ball.
assets.prompt: ONE BALL. A single plain bright-red rubber ball lies alone on short green grass, sharp and large in the middle of the photo. Nothing else: no people, no goal, no other balls. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere.

assets.item: A team / They are a team.
assets.prompt: A TEAM. Eight adult players in identical plain yellow shirts and blue shorts pose together for a team photo on a grass field: four stand in a row behind and four kneel in front, arms around each other's shoulders, all smiling at the camera, with one ball on the grass in front of them. The shirts are completely plain. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere. Every visible hand has five natural fingers.

assets.item: A game / It is a game.
assets.prompt: A GAME in progress. Two teams play a football match on a grass field, seen from the side line: players in plain red shirts and players in plain blue shirts run after the ball in the middle of the photo, one red player kicking it, with a goal visible at the far end and a few spectators blurred behind. It is clearly a match between two teams. The shirts are completely plain. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere.

TENNIS. Two adults play tennis on an outdoor court, seen from behind one of them: the near player, a woman in white, swings her racket at the yellow ball, and the far player, a man in white, waits on the other side of the net. The net, both rackets and the ball are clearly visible. Exactly two people; plain clothes. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere.

assets.item: Sing / I sing a song. / I like to sing.

reference_file.observed_description: Ana, a woman of about thirty with long wavy black hair, an olive-green button shirt open over a white top, sits at a wooden kitchen table holding a cup of coffee and a slice of toast and smiles, in a bright kitchen.

assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Ana: about thirty, long wavy black hair, an olive-green button shirt open over a white top. Keep her face, hair and clothes exactly. Create a NEW photograph: Ana SINGS: she stands at a microphone on a stand, holds it with one hand, her mouth wide open in song and her eyes half closed with feeling, her other hand raised. She is seen from the waist up in a plain room. Exactly one person; no instruments, no audience. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere. Every visible hand has five natural fingers.

A SONG. One open music book stands on a black music stand, both pages filled with printed musical notes on staves, sharp and large in the middle of the photo; a microphone on a stand is beside it. The pages show ONLY musical notes and staff lines: no title, no lyrics, no letters, no words and no numbers anywhere. No people.

Seen from the waist up. Exactly three people; no instruments, no microphone. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere. Every visible hand has five natural fingers.
